questions.correct_rationale: Variable sets share variables across workspaces.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual copies drift, code credentials leak, and one workspace mixes environments.

questions.subdomain: 8c Organize and use HCP Terraform workspaces and projects
questions.question: Workspaces for a business unit should be grouped with shared permissions. What should be used?
questions.correct_rationale: Projects organize workspaces and scope permissions.
questions.distractor_summary: Branches, aliases, and moved blocks do not group workspaces.

questions.subdomain: 8c Organize and use HCP Terraform workspaces and projects
questions.question: How do HCP Terraform workspaces differ from CLI workspaces?
options: HCP Terraform workspaces include separate variables, permissions, and runs, while CLI workspaces only separate state in one backend
HCP Terraform workspaces cannot store state
questions.correct_rationale: HCP Terraform workspaces are richer than CLI workspaces.
questions.distractor_summary: They differ, CLI workspaces lack team permissions, and HCP workspaces do store state.

questions.subdomain: 8c Organize and use HCP Terraform workspaces and projects
questions.question: A workspace should notify a team chat when a run fails. What should be configured?
options: Workspace notifications to Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or a webhook
questions.correct_rationale: Notifications send run events to destinations.
questions.distractor_summary: Aliases, lifecycle, and moved blocks do not notify.

questions.subdomain: 8d Configure and use HCP Terraform integration
questions.question: Which command stores an HCP Terraform API token for the CLI?
questions.correct_rationale: terraform login obtains and saves a token.
questions.distractor_summary: The other commands do not log in.

questions.subdomain: 8d Configure and use HCP Terraform integration
questions.question: A workspace should automatically apply successful plans from the main branch. What setting is used?
questions.correct_rationale: Auto-apply skips manual confirmation for successful plans.
questions.distractor_summary: The other settings do not control applying runs.

questions.subdomain: 8d Configure and use HCP Terraform integration
questions.question: One workspace's output values are needed by another workspace. What is a good approach in HCP Terraform?
options: Use the tfe_outputs data source or remote state sharing settings to read the outputs
questions.correct_rationale: Output sharing lets workspaces consume each other's outputs safely.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual copies and hard-coding go stale, and merging removes separation.

questions.subdomain: 8d Configure and use HCP Terraform integration
questions.question: Which HCP Terraform feature can check workspaces regularly for drift and failing checks?
options: Health assessments (drift detection and continuous validation)
questions.correct_rationale: Health assessments detect drift and check block failures.
questions.distractor_summary: fmt, aliases, and local backends do not detect drift.

questions.subdomain: 7a Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace
questions.question: After an import block has been applied successfully, what can be done with it?
options: It can be removed from configuration or kept as a record, because the resource is now in state
It must stay forever or the resource is destroyed
It must be converted into a moved block
It must be copied into every module
questions.correct_rationale: Import blocks are idempotent, and removing them later does not affect the resource.
questions.distractor_summary: Removal does not destroy the resource, and conversion or copying is not required.

questions.subdomain: 7a Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace
questions.question: Several existing resources of the same type must be imported from a map of IDs. What can import blocks use?
options: A separate CLI command per resource is the only option
for_each in the import block, matching for_each instances in the resource
questions.correct_rationale: Import blocks support for_each for bulk imports.
questions.distractor_summary: Providers do not take count, CLI imports are not the only option, and depends_on does not import.

questions.subdomain: 7b Use the CLI to inspect state
questions.question: Which command returns a single output value without quotes, for use in shell scripts?
questions.correct_rationale: -raw prints a string output without quoting.
questions.distractor_summary: The other commands do not support this use.

questions.subdomain: 7c Use verbose logging
questions.question: Logs at the most detailed level are needed to debug a provider crash. Which TF_LOG value gives the most detail?
questions.correct_rationale: TRACE is the most verbose log level.
questions.distractor_summary: ERROR, WARN, and INFO show less detail.

questions.subdomain: 8a Use HCP Terraform to create infrastructure
questions.question: Where is state stored for an HCP Terraform workspace?
options: In HCP Terraform, encrypted and versioned for that workspace
questions.correct_rationale: HCP Terraform manages state storage with history.
questions.distractor_summary: Laptops, the registry, and Git do not hold workspace state.

questions.subdomain: 8b Describe HCP Terraform collaboration and governance features
questions.question: Users must be able to see estimated monthly cost changes before applying. Which HCP Terraform feature helps?
options: Cost estimation in runs, which policies can also check
questions.correct_rationale: Cost estimation shows expected cost changes in a run.
questions.distractor_summary: fmt, aliases, and lock files do not estimate costs.

questions.subdomain: 8c Organize and use HCP Terraform workspaces and projects
questions.question: How should separate environments such as dev and prod usually be organized in HCP Terraform?
options: In one workspace with a variable switch changed by hand
In separate organizations for every developer
As separate workspaces, often grouped in a project, with their own variables and permissions
questions.correct_rationale: Separate workspaces isolate state and access per environment.
questions.distractor_summary: One workspace or state mixes environments, and per-developer orgs are hard to govern.

questions.subdomain: 8d Configure and use HCP Terraform integration
questions.question: A workspace must trigger a run when another workspace applies successfully. What feature supports this?
options: Run triggers that connect a source workspace to the dependent workspace
questions.correct_rationale: Run triggers queue runs after upstream workspaces apply.
questions.distractor_summary: graph shows dependencies locally, and moved blocks or aliases do not trigger runs.
